composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. creative_direction: Print a cobalt lobster with its two broad claws folded inward above the head, forming a compact open heart-like gap. Keep antennae short and body segments broad.
